rv.q: The Morbs is–in these post-COVID days–a very unsettling and engaging work that finds some big laughs even at moments that shouldn't be all that funny.
Those minor missteps do not detract from the overall strength of the play.

cn.t: Jen Diamond's cabin-in-the-woods tale earns praise as powerful ensemble theatre that transcends its genre premise, delivering a deeply affecting story of female friendship amid crisis.
